RTI.definition: A law (RTI Act 2005) that lets any Indian citizen request information from any government body within 30 days.

RTS.definition: Tamil Nadu Right to Services Act 2010 — government offices must deliver notified services within fixed time limits or face penalty.

Death Certificate.definition: Mandatory legal document issued by a Registrar of Births and Deaths confirming a person's death. Required for almost all post-death procedures.

Legal Heir Certificate.definition: A certificate issued by a Tahsildar identifying the rightful heirs of a deceased person. Required to claim pension, bank accounts, and property.

Tahsildar.definition: A revenue officer at the taluk level who handles land records, income certificates, community certificates, and legal heir certificates.

Mutation.definition: The process of updating land revenue records to reflect the new owner's name after a transfer, inheritance, or purchase.

Encumbrance Certificate.definition: A document from the Sub-Registrar's office listing all registered transactions (loans, mortgages) on a property over a period.

Patta.definition: A land ownership document maintained by the Revenue Department showing who legally owns a piece of land in Tamil Nadu.

Aadhaar.definition: 12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI to every Indian resident, used for KYC verification across government services.

PAN.definition: 10-character alphanumeric identifier issued by the Income Tax Department for tax-related transactions and bank accounts.

Pension Transfer.definition: The process by which a deceased government employee's pension benefits are transferred to the surviving spouse or dependants.

Succession Certificate.definition: A court-issued certificate authorising the holder to collect debts and securities owed to a deceased person. Issued by a Civil Court.

Sub-Registrar.definition: A government official responsible for registering property transactions, wills, and other legal documents within a sub-district.

TNEB.definition: State electricity utility that handles power connections, billing, and name transfer of electricity accounts.

DRO.definition: Senior revenue official overseeing land records, certificates, and property-related disputes at the district level.
